# Agent Client 0.29.2

This corrective maintenance release removes dependency declarations that were introduced only to
make a reactor-generated SBOM resemble the independently certified consumer graph. Product
dependency semantics are again determined by production, security, and compatibility needs; the
certified consumer-rooted SBOM is published by the central release procedure.

All legitimate 0.29.1 maintenance updates remain, including the current Agent Sandbox and Agent
Journal sibling releases and the previously selected third-party maintenance versions.
